title: Japanese Zaru Soba
summary: Chilled buckwheat noodles served with a savoury soy-dashi dipping sauce, spring onions and wasabi.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Combine dashi, soy and mirin in a small saucepan; simmer 2 minutes to cook off the alcohol, then chill completely.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil and add soba, stirring immediately so strands do not stick.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Cook according to packet instructions, usually 4–6 minutes; drain and rinse thoroughly under cold running water to remove starch and stop cooking.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Drain well, arrange noodles on plates with sliced nori and serve chilled dipping sauce separately with spring onions and wasabi.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a covered container for up to 2 days; reheat until piping hot.

title: Indian Aloo Paratha
summary: Golden wholewheat flatbreads stuffed with spiced mashed potatoes, crisp outside and soft within.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Mix atta with water and a pinch of salt into a supple dough; knead briefly, cover and rest 20 minutes.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Boil potatoes until tender, drain thoroughly and mash smooth; fold in finely chopped chilli, cumin, garam masala and coriander.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Divide dough and filling into six portions; wrap dough around each filling ball, seal and roll gently into 18 cm rounds with flour.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Cook each paratha on a hot dry skillet for 2 minutes per side, brushing with ghee until both sides develop golden spots; serve hot.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a covered container for up to 2 days; reheat until piping hot.

title: Greek Revithada
summary: Chickpeas slowly baked with onion, bay leaf and lemon until creamy in a fragrant olive-oil broth.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Soak dried chickpeas overnight in plenty of cold water, then drain and rinse; preheat oven to 160°C.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Slice onions and place in a lidded casserole with chickpeas, bay leaves, olive oil and enough water to cover by 3 cm.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Cover tightly and bake 3–4 hours until chickpeas are completely tender, checking liquid occasionally and adding boiling water if needed.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Season only once tender, squeeze in lemon juice and rest 15 minutes; mash a few chickpeas into the broth to thicken before serving.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a covered container for up to 2 days; reheat until piping hot.

title: French Clafoutis aux Cerises
summary: Sweet cherries baked in a delicate vanilla custard with lightly golden edges and a soft centre.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 180°C and butter a 24 cm baking dish; scatter pitted cherries evenly across the base.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Whisk eggs with sugar until smooth, then add flour gradually to avoid lumps; whisk in milk and vanilla to make a thin batter.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Pour batter gently over cherries and bake 35–40 minutes until puffed, lightly golden and just set in the centre.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Rest at least 15 minutes so custard firms slightly; dust lightly with icing sugar and serve warm or at room temperature.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days; serve freshly prepared when texture is important.

title: Korean Kongnamul Guk
summary: A light, clean-tasting soybean sprout soup simmered with garlic, spring onion and anchovy broth.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Rinse soybean sprouts thoroughly, discard any damaged sprouts and finely mince garlic and spring onions.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Bring stock to a boil, add sprouts and garlic, cover and simmer 8–10 minutes without repeatedly lifting the lid.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Season with soy sauce and a little salt; simmer uncovered 2 minutes more until sprouts are tender but retain a little crunch.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Finish with spring onions and a few drops of sesame oil; serve hot alongside rice.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days; serve freshly prepared when texture is important.

title: Peruvian Arroz Chaufa
summary: Peruvian-Chinese fried rice with chicken, eggs, spring onions and a deeply savoury soy glaze.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Use chilled cooked rice and break up clumps; dice chicken into small pieces and beat eggs lightly.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Heat a wok until hot, scramble eggs quickly in a little oil and remove; stir-fry chicken 5–7 minutes until fully cooked.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Add garlic and spring onion whites for 30 seconds, then rice; toss over high heat 3–4 minutes until heated throughout and lightly toasted.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Return eggs, add soy sauce and sesame oil, toss until evenly coloured and finish with sliced spring onion greens.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a covered container for up to 2 days; reheat until piping hot.

title: Filipino Arroz Caldo
summary: Comforting ginger chicken rice porridge with garlic, spring onions and a squeeze of calamansi or lime.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Rinse rice and drain; slice ginger into fine matchsticks, dice onion and mince garlic; cut chicken into bite-size pieces.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Soften onion, ginger and garlic in a little oil for 5 minutes; add chicken and cook until its exterior turns opaque.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Stir in rice, pour over stock and simmer gently 30–40 minutes, stirring regularly until grains break down and chicken is fully cooked.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Season with fish sauce, thin with hot water to a porridge consistency and garnish with spring onions and lime.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a covered container for up to 2 days; reheat until piping hot.

title: Ethiopian Atakilt Wat
summary: Tender cabbage, potatoes and carrots simmered with turmeric, ginger and gentle Ethiopian spices.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Cut cabbage into wide strips, potatoes into 2 cm cubes and carrots into thick half-moons; dice onion and mince garlic.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Soften onion in oil for 8 minutes, add garlic, ginger and turmeric and stir for 30 seconds without scorching.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Add potatoes and carrots with 150 ml water, cover and cook 12 minutes; add cabbage and cook covered another 12–15 minutes until tender.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Remove lid to evaporate excess moisture, season with salt and serve warm alongside injera or other mains.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days; serve freshly prepared when texture is important.

title: Syrian Fatteh
summary: Crisp pita layered with warm chickpeas, garlicky yoghurt, toasted pine nuts and lemon.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Toast torn pita at 190°C for 10 minutes until golden and crisp.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Warm drained chickpeas in a little water for 5 minutes; mix yoghurt with crushed garlic, lemon and salt.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Brown pine nuts in butter over medium-low heat, stirring constantly so they do not scorch.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Layer pita, chickpeas and yoghurt in bowls; spoon warm pine-nut butter over just before serving.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a covered container for up to 2 days; reheat until piping hot.

title: Georgian Badrijani Nigvzit
summary: Thin fried aubergine rolls filled with fragrant walnut, garlic and coriander paste.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Slice aubergines lengthways into 5 mm strips, salt lightly and pat dry after 15 minutes.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Pan-fry slices in batches with a little oil until soft and golden, about 3 minutes each side.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Blend walnuts, garlic, coriander, vinegar and enough water to form a spreadable paste.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Spread walnut mixture over cooled aubergine slices, roll up and garnish with parsley.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days; serve freshly prepared when texture is important.

title: Japanese Ochazuke
summary: Steamed rice bathed in hot green tea with salmon flakes, nori and sesame.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Cook rice and keep warm; flake fully cooked salmon, removing skin and bones.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Brew green tea just before serving and season lightly with soy sauce.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Divide rice among four bowls and top with salmon, thin spring onion and strips of nori.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Pour hot tea around rice at the table, sprinkle sesame and serve immediately.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a covered container for up to 2 days; reheat until piping hot.

title: Italian Polenta con Funghi
summary: Creamy Parmesan polenta topped with buttery mushrooms, garlic and thyme.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Slice mushrooms and mince garlic; bring stock to a gentle boil.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Whisk polenta into stock gradually and cook according to packet instructions, stirring until thick.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Sauté mushrooms in half the butter over medium-high heat until browned; add garlic and thyme for 1 minute.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Stir remaining butter and Parmesan into polenta; spoon mushrooms over and serve hot.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a covered container for up to 2 days; reheat until piping hot.

title: Persian Mast o Khiar
summary: Cool thick yoghurt with diced cucumber, mint, walnuts and a hint of dried rose.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Finely dice cucumber and pat dry to avoid watering down the yoghurt.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Toast walnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes, then cool and chop.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Stir cucumber, mint, walnuts and raisins through yoghurt; season lightly with salt.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Chill 20 minutes, scatter rose petals over if using and serve with flatbread.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days; serve freshly prepared when texture is important.

title: Indian Upma
summary: Fluffy savoury semolina cooked with mustard seeds, curry leaves, vegetables and lemon.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Toast semolina in a dry pan over low heat for 5 minutes until fragrant, then set aside.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Heat oil, sizzle mustard seeds and curry leaves, then soften diced onion and carrot.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Add water and peas, bring to a simmer, then whisk in semolina gradually to prevent lumps.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Cover on low heat 4–5 minutes until fluffy; finish with lemon juice and serve hot.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a covered container for up to 2 days; reheat until piping hot.

title: Japanese Yaki Onigiri
summary: Grilled rice triangles with crisp soy-glazed surfaces and tender centres.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Let freshly cooked rice cool until comfortable to handle but still sticky.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: With damp hands, press rice firmly into eight compact triangles so they hold together.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Heat a lightly oiled non-stick pan over medium heat and grill triangles 3–4 minutes each side until crusted.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Brush with soy and mirin, grill 30 seconds per side to caramelise and serve warm.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days; serve freshly prepared when texture is important.

title: Mexican Calabacitas
summary: Tender courgette and sweetcorn sautéed with tomatoes, onion and mild green chilli.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Dice courgettes and tomatoes evenly, and finely chop onion and chilli.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Soften onion in oil for 5 minutes, then add chilli and courgette.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Cook 6 minutes until courgette starts to soften; add tomatoes and corn and simmer 5 minutes.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Season with salt, scatter crumbled cheese over and serve while vegetables retain texture.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days; serve freshly prepared when texture is important.

title: Italian Semolina Gnocchi alla Romana
summary: Golden baked semolina rounds enriched with butter and Parmesan, crisp on top and tender inside.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat milk and salt until steaming, then whisk in semolina in a steady stream.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Stir over low heat 8–10 minutes until very thick; beat in half the butter, yolks and half the Parmesan.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Spread mixture 1.5 cm thick on a greased tray, cool until firm, then cut into rounds.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Overlap rounds in a buttered dish, scatter remaining butter and cheese, and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a covered container for up to 2 days; reheat until piping hot.

title: Vietnamese Ca Kho To
summary: Tender fish steaks braised in caramelised fish sauce with black pepper and spring onion.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Cut fish into large pieces and pat dry; mince garlic and shallots.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Heat sugar with 1 tbsp water in a small heavy pan until amber, then carefully add remaining water.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Add fish sauce, garlic and shallots; nestle fish into sauce and simmer gently 12–15 minutes until cooked.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Reduce sauce until glossy, baste fish carefully and finish with pepper and spring onions.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a covered container for up to 2 days; reheat until piping hot.

title: Spanish Espinacas con Garbanzos
summary: Chickpeas and spinach simmered with smoky paprika, cumin and a garlic-bread thickener.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Drain chickpeas and wash spinach; tear bread into pieces.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Fry bread and garlic in olive oil until golden; blend with paprika, cumin and a splash of stock.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Simmer chickpeas with remaining stock for 8 minutes, then stir in garlic-bread paste.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Add spinach by handfuls until wilted and sauce thickens; season and serve with lemon.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a covered container for up to 2 days; reheat until piping hot.

title: Korean Gyeran Jjim
summary: Cloudlike steamed eggs with spring onions, gently cooked until soft and trembling.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Beat eggs gently with cooled stock and fish sauce until evenly mixed.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Strain mixture through a fine sieve for a smoother custard; slice spring onions.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Pour into a heatproof bowl, cover loosely and steam over barely simmering water for 12–15 minutes.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Check centre is softly set rather than liquid, then top with spring onions and sesame oil.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days; serve freshly prepared when texture is important.

title: Brazilian Farofa
summary: Toasted cassava flour with buttery onions and bacon for a crunchy savoury accompaniment.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Finely dice bacon and onion, and chop parsley.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Cook bacon in a dry skillet over medium heat until crisp, then remove and reserve.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Soften onion in bacon fat and butter for 6 minutes, then add cassava flour.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Stir continuously over medium-low heat for 5 minutes until lightly toasted; return bacon and add parsley.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days; serve freshly prepared when texture is important.

title: Italian Bresaola Rucola e Grana
summary: Paper-thin cured beef layered with peppery rocket, Parmesan shavings and lemon.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Wash and thoroughly dry rocket so dressing clings without diluting.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Arrange bresaola slices loosely across four chilled plates.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Whisk lemon juice with olive oil and pepper, then toss rocket lightly in half the dressing.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Pile rocket over beef, shave Parmesan on top and drizzle with remaining dressing before serving.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a covered container for up to 2 days; reheat until piping hot.

title: Greek Melitzanosalata
summary: Smoky aubergine dip with lemon, garlic, parsley and fruity olive oil.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Prick aubergines and roast at 220°C for 35–45 minutes until collapsed and deeply softened.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Cool until handleable, split and scoop flesh into a sieve to drain excess moisture.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Chop flesh roughly and mix with crushed garlic, lemon juice, olive oil and salt.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Fold through parsley and rest 15 minutes for flavours to mingle; serve with pita.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days; serve freshly prepared when texture is important.

title: Egyptian Basbousa
summary: Tender semolina cake soaked in fragrant lemon syrup and topped with toasted almonds.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 180°C; mix semolina, sugar, yoghurt, butter and baking powder until just combined.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Spread into a greased 20 cm square tin, score portions and press an almond into each if available.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Bake 30–35 minutes until golden; meanwhile simmer syrup sugar, water and lemon for 8 minutes.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Pour warm syrup evenly over hot cake, then rest at least 1 hour before cutting along score marks.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days; serve freshly prepared when texture is important.

title: Turkish Mercimek Kofte
summary: Soft red lentil and bulgur patties seasoned with pepper paste, cumin and fresh herbs.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Rinse lentils and simmer in 500 ml water for 15 minutes until soft and thick.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Remove from heat, stir bulgur into hot lentils, cover and rest 15 minutes until hydrated.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Soften diced onion in oil, add tomato paste and cumin, then fold through lentils with herbs and lemon.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Cool until handleable, shape into small oval patties and serve in lettuce leaves.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a covered container for up to 2 days; reheat until piping hot.

title: Japanese Sunomono
summary: Cool cucumber ribbons dressed in sweet rice vinegar with sesame and delicate wakame seaweed.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Slice cucumbers paper-thin, sprinkle with salt and rest 10 minutes.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Soak wakame in cold water until expanded, then drain and squeeze dry.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Whisk rice vinegar, sugar and soy until sugar dissolves; squeeze excess water from cucumber.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Toss cucumber and wakame with dressing, sprinkle sesame and serve chilled.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days; serve freshly prepared when texture is important.

title: Indian Dhokla
summary: Fluffy steamed chickpea cakes topped with mustard seeds, curry leaves and fresh coriander.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Whisk chickpea flour, yoghurt, water, turmeric and salt into a smooth batter.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Prepare a steamer and grease a shallow cake tin; stir fruit salt into batter immediately before steaming.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Pour into tin and steam covered for 15–18 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Sizzle mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil, spoon over cake and cut into squares.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a covered container for up to 2 days; reheat until piping hot.

title: French Tarte Fine aux Pommes
summary: Thin apple slices baked on crisp buttery puff pastry with a glossy apricot glaze.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 200°C and place pastry on a lined tray; score a narrow border.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Core and slice apples thinly, toss with lemon juice and arrange overlapping inside border.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Brush with melted butter, sprinkle sugar and bake 25–30 minutes until pastry is crisp and apples golden.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Warm apricot jam with a teaspoon of water and brush over hot apples; cool 10 minutes before slicing.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days; serve freshly prepared when texture is important.

title: Korean Sigeumchi Namul
summary: Tender spinach dressed with sesame oil, garlic and toasted sesame for a simple banchan.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Wash spinach thoroughly and bring a large pan of water to the boil.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Blanch spinach for 30–45 seconds, then plunge into cold water to stop cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Squeeze out excess water gently and cut into shorter lengths; mince garlic finely.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Toss spinach with garlic, sesame oil and soy, then scatter sesame seeds over.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days; serve freshly prepared when texture is important.

title: Persian Adas Polo
summary: Fragrant rice layered with lentils, caramelised onions, raisins and warm cinnamon.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Rinse rice and soak 20 minutes; simmer lentils separately until just tender, about 20 minutes.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Slice onions and cook slowly in oil for 15 minutes until deeply golden; stir in raisins and cinnamon.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Parboil rice in salted water for 5 minutes, drain, then layer in a pot with lentils and onion mixture.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Dot with butter, cover with a tea-towel-wrapped lid and steam on low for 25 minutes until fluffy.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a covered container for up to 2 days; reheat until piping hot.

title: Chinese Liangban Huanggua
summary: Smashed cucumber in a punchy black-vinegar dressing with garlic, chilli and sesame.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Smash cucumbers gently with the side of a cleaver until cracked, then break into bite-size pieces.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Salt lightly and rest 10 minutes, then drain off released water to keep the salad crisp.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Whisk minced garlic, vinegar, soy, chilli oil, sesame oil and sugar until dissolved.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Toss cucumbers through dressing just before serving and chill briefly if preferred.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days; serve freshly prepared when texture is important.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 190°C and line a tray; drain ricotta well and zest lemon.

stages.title: Develop flavours
steps: Mix ricotta, egg, sugar, lemon zest and raisins into a thick filling.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Spoon filling along one side of pastry, fold and seal edges firmly, then brush with melted butter.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Bake 30–35 minutes until deep golden and filling is set; rest 15 minutes before slicing.

tips: Check the texture and doneness described in the method rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days; serve freshly prepared when texture is important.
